records.rationale: Both proposals agree PingPlotter Pro is non-AI. Retained official Professional page details graphical ping/traceroute, multi-target monitoring, route summaries, alerts, REST API, and standard latency/loss/jitter/MOS metrics, matching record's network troubleshooting product and supporting conventional diagnostics. No credible contradictory AI claim appears in inspected product evidence; judgment rests on substantive coverage, not search failure.
